about_the_game:
Grants access to the Builders' Vault Bundle for GUNDAM BREAKER 4.

Content:
- Additional Builders Parts/Emblems
- Additional Diorama Items (Diorama Base, Diorama Objects, Diorama Gunpla)
- Enhance Items
Parts Enhance I x 200
Parts Enhance II x 200
Parts Enhance III x 200
- Evolve Items
Parts Evolve I x 200
Parts Evolve II x 200

*This product is also available in the Builder and Power-Up Set. Be careful of duplicate purchases.
*Limited to one purchase per account.
*Items in excess of the maximum number allowed will be discarded.
